file 644 @S/units/orbit-ci-ci@.service
  | # Managed by the runner lanes kit (bin/provision-lane.sh); do not edit on the machine.
  | # One ci slot of the orbit-ci lane. The lane's listener (orbit-ci-listener.service) writes the slot's JIT
  | # config and job file under @S/run/ci/<n>/ and starts this unit for that one job; the
  | # container takes the job and exits, and the unit stays down until the listener starts it again.
  | # No [Install]: an instance started at boot would have no job to run. See README.md.
  | [Unit]
  | Description=orbit-ci lane ci slot %i (one disposable Sysbox container per job)
  | Requires=docker.service sysbox.service
  | After=docker.service sysbox.service network-online.target
  | Wants=network-online.target
  | RequiresMountsFor=@S/state @S/state/store
  | # Never refuse a start: the listener may start one instance several times a minute.
  | StartLimitIntervalSec=0
  | 
  | [Service]
  | Type=simple
  | Slice=orbit-ci.slice
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_NAME=orbit-ci
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_SCOPE=org
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_SLOT_GB=10
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_BRIDGE=orbit-ci0
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_GH_HOSTS=@S/state/home/.config/gh/hosts.yml
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_STATE_DIR=@S/state
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_STORE_DIR=@S/state/store
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_RUN_DIR=@S/run
  | # Each instance's 4-core set (systemd expands %i first, then ${KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_<n>}), so a job
  | # sees nproc=4 like a hosted runner.
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_1=0-3
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_2=4-7
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_3=8-11
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_4=12-15
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_5=0-3
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_6=4-7
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_7=8-11
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_8=12-15
  | # KNOWN_CI_IMAGE_TAG, written by bin/build-runner-image.sh; read at every start, so a rebuilt image
  | # (and its preloaded store, which prepare snapshots) is picked up by the next job without touching
  | # this unit.
  | EnvironmentFile=@S/state/image.env
  | ExecStartPre=+@ROOT/bin/lane-slot.sh prepare ci %i
  | ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --rm --runtime=sysbox-runc --network orbit-ci --cgroup-parent orbit-ci.slice --memory 4g --pids-limit 2048 --tmpfs /tmp:size=2g,exec --oom-score-adj 1000 --dns 1.1.1.1 --dns 8.8.8.8 --cpuset-cpus ${KNOWN_CI_CPUSET_%i} -v @S/state/slot-ci-%i:/home/runner -v @S/state/store/slot-ci-%i:/var/lib/docker -v @S/run/ci/%i/jit:/run/jit:ro --name orbit-ci-ci-%i orbit-ci-runner:${KNOWN_CI_IMAGE_TAG}
  | ExecStopPost=+@ROOT/bin/lane-slot.sh cleanup ci %i
  | # One job per start: the listener starts the next.
  | Restart=no
  | # runtime_max_sec, plus warm_max_age_sec for a lane with a warm pool: systemd counts it from the
  | # unit's start, and the listener recycles a warm slot once it has been up warm_max_age_sec, so a
  | # job the slot takes just before still has the whole runtime_max_sec.
  | RuntimeMaxSec=4800
  | # The slot helper's back-off sleeps up to ten minutes inside ExecStartPre.
  | TimeoutStartSec=15min
  | # Also the cleanup's budget (ExecStopPost). The cleanup renames the job's store into
  | # @S/state/store/trash for orbit-ci-store-reaper.service and deletes nothing of it; what can still take minutes is a
  | # qae store's lock (120 s) and a store the trash could not take, which is deleted here. Deleting one
  | # (270k files) took 20 to over 60 s on a loaded machine (2026-10-05), and at 60 s systemd killed 195
  | # of 332 cleanups, whose rm kept running beside the next job's snapshot on the same store.
  | TimeoutStopSec=300
file 644 @S/units/orbit-ci-image-build.service
  | # Managed by the runner lanes kit (bin/provision-lane.sh); do not edit on the machine.
  | # The orbit-ci lane's weekly image rebuild: --refresh builds orbit-ci-runner:<today>-<hash> unless it exists,
  | # so each week re-reads the preloaded repositories' supabase/config.toml and re-preloads the images
  | # they start (bin/build-runner-image.sh). --if-provisioned makes it a logged no-op until Sysbox and
  | # the lane's store exist. It holds the lane's build lock, as every caller of the build does.
  | [Unit]
  | Description=orbit-ci lane: rebuild the runner image orbit-ci-runner
  | Wants=network-online.target
  | After=docker.service network-online.target
  | 
  | [Service]
  | Type=oneshot
  | WorkingDirectory=@ROOT
  | ExecStart=/usr/bin/flock -o /run/orbit-ci-runner-build.lock @ROOT/bin/build-runner-image.sh box orbit-ci --refresh --if-provisioned

file 644 @S/units/orbit-ci-store-reaper.service
  | # Managed by the runner lanes kit (bin/provision-lane.sh); do not edit on the machine.
  | # The orbit-ci lane's store reaper (bin/lane-slot.sh reap): deletes the store copies its slots retired
  | # into @S/state/store/trash under one lock: one at a time, or a few at a time while the store is under
  | # pressure (REAP_JOBS in that script). Every slot's cleanup starts it without waiting (systemctl
  | # start --no-block), and orbit-ci-store-reaper.timer does, so no copy is left there by a start that was
  | # missed or by a reboot. No start timeout (a oneshot has none): emptying a backlog is its job, and a
  | # killed run would only begin again where it stopped. A run that never ends replaces itself now
  | # and then, between deletes, with the helper on disk (REAP_MAX_SEC there), so a pulled helper
  | # reaches it.
  | [Unit]
  | Description=orbit-ci lane: delete the store copies its slots retired
  | RequiresMountsFor=@S/state/store
  | # Never refuse a start: a cleanup starts it after every job, several times within seconds when jobs
  | # end together, and a refused start would leave a copy in the trash until the timer.
  | StartLimitIntervalSec=0
  | 
  | [Service]
  | Type=oneshot
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_NAME=orbit-ci
  | Environment=KNOWN_CI_STORE_DIR=@S/state/store
  | ExecStart=@ROOT/bin/lane-slot.sh reap
  | # The lowest CPU priority, so a delete yields to everything else it shares a core with. It runs
  | # outside orbit-ci.slice on purpose: the lane's CPUQuota and MemoryHigh throttle what is in the slice, and
  | # the one thing that gives the store its space back must not stall with the jobs that fill it.
  | Nice=19
file 644 @S/units/orbit-ci-store-reaper.timer
  | # Managed by the runner lanes kit (bin/provision-lane.sh); do not edit on the machine.
  | # A minute after boot, then every 5 minutes, counted from the reaper's last activation: the
  | # backstop for a copy no cleanup's start reached, not the reaper's usual trigger.
  | [Unit]
  | Description=orbit-ci lane: delete retired store copies, every 5 minutes
  | 
  | [Timer]
  | OnBootSec=1min
  | OnUnitActiveSec=5min
  | 
  | [Install]
  | WantedBy=timers.target
